review_kind: AI-assisted bilingual source audit by the implementation agent, not human review or professional certification

known_failures.failure: English present progressive becomes French imperfect past. The frozen link is not an intact tense-preserving reference.
English asks whether to report inability to work. French asks whether to report why one cannot work, adding a request for reasons.
known_failures.english_evidence: Do I have to tell the employer that I'm unable to work?
known_failures.french_evidence: Est-ce que je dois dire à l'employeur, pourquoi je suis incapable de travailler ?

known_failures.failure: The French reference omits the requirement to book in advance.
known_failures.english_evidence: You have to book in advance.

known_failures.failure: English their is plural-possessor ownership. French ses names a singular possessor. The ownership relation changes.
English inability to act accordingly becomes French inability to agree. Understanding, action and agreement are different claims.
known_failures.english_evidence: While I understand what you are saying, I cannot do accordingly.
known_failures.french_evidence: Bien que je comprenne ce que vous dites, je ne peux pas être d'accord avec vous.

remaining_review_scope: Other register, grammar, specificity and tense issues were observed. The five listed failures are sufficient to reject this frozen pilot. This list is not an exhaustive professional translation audit.
source_references: Exact author or credited contributor, sentence URI, source lines and export hashes remain in pilot-manifest.json. Full original grants remain in rights.json.
final_boundary: Original groups and texts were frozen before this review. No replacement, source-text correction, reselection or threshold change follows this final audit.
